title: Oficina frente a oficina
reviewer: R33 local source-followup; manual source-to-claim review

semanticReview.method: Revisión semántica manual contra las fuentes primarias enlazadas en Evidence; se cotejaron los sentidos/afirmaciones materiales con los localizadores registrados. Se excluyeron de la redacción final las generalizaciones no respaldadas.

findings.summary: Michaelis lists Brazilian Portuguese oficina as a place for an occupation, a vehicle repair site, and a short practical workshop; its escritório entry identifies a room or group of rooms for client service/business. DLE lists oficina as a place where something is done/ordered/worked and as a department where public/private employees work, demonstrating overlap but distinct recorded uses.
